subject: Re: Kickoff: ALOE — discrete energy-based models via local exploration
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing for Sirocco: Hyun leads at 70%, Kaia 50% on the energy model and sampler, Bilal 40% on the fuzzing harness and seed ingest, Yusuf 20% advisory on evaluation.

Compute: 32 A100s on titan-a100 best-effort. The synthetic runs are small (500 epochs on the varlen configs finishes overnight), but the fuzzing track needs a Docker-capable pool to build the LibFuzzer binaries and collect seed inputs — that's an infra ask, not a GPU ask, and I've opened it with Ines.

Flagging: pretrained model dumps and data have to be mirrored internally before Bilal can start. Kaia is doing that this week.

Ivo
